description: This file defines the PostService struct and its methods for manipulating posts in Mattermost, including creating, updating, deleting posts, handling ephemeral messages, retrieving post threads, and managing reactions. It also includes logic for filtering messages based on various criteria.

classes.name: PostService
classes.description: A service providing methods to manipulate posts, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, reactions, and message filtering.

methods.name: CreatePost
methods.description: Creates a new post using the API and copies the created post data back.

methods.name: DM
methods.description: Sends a direct message from one user to another by creating a direct channel and posting.

methods.name: GetPost
methods.description: Retrieves a post by its ID.

methods.name: DeletePost
methods.description: Deletes a post by its ID.

methods.name: SendEphemeralPost
methods.description: Creates an ephemeral post for a user.

methods.name: UpdateEphemeralPost
methods.description: Updates a previously sent ephemeral post.

methods.name: DeleteEphemeralPost
methods.description: Deletes a previously sent ephemeral post.

methods.name: GetPostThread
methods.description: Retrieves all posts in the same thread as the given post.

methods.name: GetPostsSince
methods.description: Retrieves posts created after a specific timestamp.

methods.name: GetPostsAfter
methods.description: Retrieves posts posted after a specific post ID.

methods.name: GetPostsBefore
methods.description: Retrieves posts posted before a specific post ID.

methods.name: GetPostsForChannel
methods.description: Retrieves posts for a specific channel.

methods.name: SearchPostsInTeam
methods.description: Searches for posts within a team matching given parameters.

methods.name: AddReaction
methods.description: Adds a reaction to a post.

methods.name: RemoveReaction
methods.description: Removes a reaction from a post.

methods.name: ShouldProcessMessage
methods.description: Determines if a message should be processed based on filtering options.
